name: Noir 3D
description: Dark rooms lit by ONE warm spot with dust in the beam, faceless dark figures with a red rim, an evidence board of photos and red string, typewriter captions. Quiet, uneasy, investigative stories.
rules: ONE light source: a warm spot from above with a visible beam and floating dust; everything else falls to black.
Figures are faceless, dark, with a thin red rim light; the subject of the story glows red. No faces, no gore, no weapons.
Evidence is physical: photos, string, files, a typed date. Show it, don't describe it.
Typewriter captions in a pale pill, one red word.
Keep exposure low and bloom on the one practical light only.
camera_language: Slow and still. Wide and low to make the figure small in the dark, medium-wide three-quarter for actions, an insert on the object that matters. Camera moves are rare (a slow push on the evidence), each with a stated reason; silence and stillness build the unease.
audio_direction: tension drone, one hard hit at the turn, quiet room tone, no cheerful sounds
pitfalls: Figures turn copper-brown if the environment light is high: keep environmentIntensity under 0.1.
Too much fog hides the board: keep fog density at or below 0.09.
